description: This file is a shell script that sets up and executes a series of tests related to Git's handling of working tree encoding conversions, including testing of various character encodings, BOM (Byte Order Mark) requirements, line ending conversions, and encoding round-trip verifications.

methods.name: test_commit_utf8_checkout_other
methods.description: A test helper function that commits a file with UTF-8 encoding, checks out with another specified encoding, and verifies the correctness of the encoding conversion.
